name: HC-PROOF Lean Codespace
postCreateCommand: curl -sSf https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leanprover/elan/master/elan-init.sh -o /tmp/elan-init.sh && sh /tmp/elan-init.sh -y --default-toolchain none && export PATH="$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH" && elan default stable && chmod +x scripts/*.sh
postStartCommand: export PATH="$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH" && bash scripts/comparator.sh || echo 'comparator: build pending — run ./scripts/comparator.sh after editing'
